body:
android/gradle.properties still carries the Raspberry Pi's limits (a 1.5 GB Gradle daemon, a 1 GB
Kotlin daemon), and the Release link of the iOS framework for a device (T-353) runs out of them:
the maintainer's macOS guest had to override them in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties. The Pi is retired;
the hosts are the Linux box the gate runs on and the macOS guest (8 cores, 16 GB). Size the repo's
settings for them (Gradle 8 GB, Kotlin daemon 6 GB, Kotlin/Native 6 GB), drop the override on the
guest, verify the device link there and the gate here, and retire the Pi from AGENTS.md's host
notes and ios/README.md.
title: build: Gradle memory sized for the current hosts, the Pi retired
